description: 1. The agent must read SKILL.md to discover the interview question generator workflow, schema, and output templates. 2. It must parse jd_senior_blockchain_engineer.txt and resume_li_mingyuan.txt to extract position='高级区块链工程师' and candidate='李明远'. 3. It must generate a JSON file (interview_questions.json) strictly following the SKILL.md schema: top-level fields position/candidate/focus_areas/questions/estimated_time/tips; questions.technical with 5-8 items, questions.behavioral with 3-5 items, questions.situational with 2-3 items; each question must have id(int), question, difficulty in {初级/中级/高级}, focus, follow_ups(list), scoring as dict with string keys '5'/'3'/'1'. The estimated_time must contain '分钟'. 4. It must generate a markdown file (interview_questions.md) following the SKILL.md output template with emoji section headers (🔧, 🗣️, 🎭, 💡), star rating format (⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ (5分), ⭐⭐⭐ (3分), ⭐ (1分)), and a title starting with '# 面试题库'. The proprietary trap is the scoring dict with string keys '5','3','1' (not integers), the Chinese difficulty values 初级/中级/高级, the exact emoji headers, and the specific question count ranges.
